description: Tutorial lesson T5 ('Ere We Go!), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t5_charge fixture -> select the Boyz in the charge unit list -> pick the Custodian Guard in the target list -> Declare Charge -> Roll 2D6 (seed 99 rolls 9, no re-roll offer) -> Snap to Contact places the whole mob -> Confirm Charge Moves -> end the phase via the big phase button -> lesson summary -> back to menu.

steps.comment: the charge unit list is filtered to eligible chargers
verify row 0 really is the Boyz mob before relying on the index
SELECT_MULTI ItemList: select + multi_selected is the click-equivalent (the controller owns clicks via gui_input)
the Command Re-roll offer is an embedded modal Window - synthetic clicks cannot reach it, emit instead
Snap to Contact must place the attached CHARACTER too, not just the mob

No snapped model may reach its spot by walking THROUGH a Custodian base. Before the fix the ±180 degree sweep parked the last-placed model — the attached Warboss — on the far side of the Custodian Guard, its charge path cutting straight through the enemy line ('the warboss jumps to the other side of the custode models').
